failures.assertion: Lists the cross-tenant reference before performance findings, and every finding carries its own complete corrected DDL with every statement written in full (never a pointer such as "same pattern as F7" or a "then: ..." shorthand list), or the exact SQL statement to run when the fix is not a schema change (for example a cleanup or retention job)
failures.evidence: F1 comes first, but F6 defers its non-UTC path with "Stop, and I will issue an expand-contract plan using `AT TIME ZONE :source_zone`" and F10 only advises "add a partial index on that predicate" without writing the DDL.

failures.assertion: Defaults to plain `EXPLAIN` for the `UPDATE` because `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` executes the statement, and allows `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` only on disposable production-like data or inside `BEGIN; ... ROLLBACK;`
failures.evidence: The output defaults to plain EXPLAIN because "`EXPLAIN ANALYZE` actually runs the statement and would ship real orders", but it never permits EXPLAIN ANALYZE on disposable data or inside `BEGIN; ... ROLLBACK;` and instead redirects to "analyze the read side as a `SELECT`".

failures.assertion: Points to the MySQL manual's EXPLAIN pages for the plan columns (for example https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/explain.html) and says their meanings vary by server version, instead of asserting version-specific column semantics from memory
failures.evidence: It links "https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/explain-output.html" but never says the meanings vary by server version, and it asserts column semantics in its own table, such as "`type` | `ref` or `range` | `ALL` (full scan of 20M rows)".

failures.assertion: Converts the text amounts to integer cents with an explicit expression in the `INSERT ... SELECT` (for example `CAST(ROUND(CAST(total AS REAL) * 100) AS INTEGER)`)
failures.evidence: The rebuild's copy is a plain `INSERT INTO new_orders (id, customer_id, total_cents) SELECT id, customer_id, total_cents FROM orders;`, and the conversion expression `CAST(round(CAST(total AS REAL) * 100) AS INTEGER)` appears only in the Phase 3 backfill `UPDATE`.
